decisions.why: examples are a Nonin oximeter carry case, charger stand, spare batteries and a BCI CO2 sample line — all accessories/consumables for pulse oximeter and capnography sensors under patient monitoring
all four examples are fluted or drop-down grab bars, i.e. bathing and toileting safety aids

Permaflow pillow, elbow pads and foot pads are pressure-relieving positioning aids for preventing pressure injury
all examples are named latex examination gloves (SafeTouch, Encore85, Micro Touch)
all examples are foam wedge positioning aids for patient positioning, matching this type's 'positioning' scope
